components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--gold, #a78b71); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--gold, #a78b71); color: #080706; font: 600 0.7rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Operating Primary Button
components.description: A compact commitment action for dense ledgers and editor sheets.
components.css: .ds-btn-operating { min-height: 35px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--gold, #a78b71); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--gold, #a78b71); color: #090806; font: 650 0.7rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-operating:hover { border-color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); background: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); } .ds-btn-operating:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-operating:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet global action that leaves the gold fill to primary commitments.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.4); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); font: 600 0.7rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); color: var(--gold-light, #c9b8a0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.12); }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: The transparent field used across career capture and detail editing.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); font: 400 0.72rem/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 9px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.35); border-radius: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f5f2ee); font: 400 1rem/1.45 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); } .ds-field input:hover { border-bottom-color: rgba(232, 213, 183, 0.65); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline: 2px solid var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Persistent navigation with a quiet tonal selected state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-is-current">Work Map</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Resume Studio</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 3px; width: 220px; padding: 10px; background: #070707; } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--gold-light, #c9b8a0); font: 500 0.95rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { background: rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.12); color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-is-current { background: rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.18); color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); }

components.name: Career Ledger Row
components.description: A selected career record that keeps role, organization, time, and place in one line of context.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; width: 300px; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 13px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(199, 164, 123, 0.12); background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f5f2ee); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ledger-row:hover, .ds-ledger-row.ds-is-selected { background: rgba(199, 164, 123, 0.09); } .ds-ledger-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-ledger-row.ds-is-selected { box-shadow: inset 1px 0 0 var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); } .ds-ledger-row strong, .ds-ledger-row b, .ds-ledger-row small { display: block; } .ds-ledger-row strong { font-size: 0.78rem; } .ds-ledger-row b { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--gold-light, #c9b8a0); font-size: 0.69rem; font-weight: 450; } .ds-ledger-row small, .ds-ledger-row em { margin-top: 4px; color: #b9aa97; font-size: 0.67rem; font-style: normal; } .ds-ledger-dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-top: 3px; border: 2px solid #080706; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold, #a78b71); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(194, 123, 43, 0.32); }

components.css: .ds-side-sheet { width: 360px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(199, 164, 123, 0.38); background: #0b0908; color: var(--text, #f5f2ee); box-shadow: -18px 0 45px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-side-sheet header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(199, 164, 123, 0.2); } .ds-side-sheet h2 { margin: 4px 0 0; font: italic 400 1.45rem/1.15 "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; } .ds-side-sheet p { margin: 3px 0 0; color: #b9aa97; font-size: 0.68rem; } .ds-side-sheet button { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(199, 164, 123, 0.32); border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--gold-light, #c9b8a0); cursor: pointer; } .ds-side-sheet button:hover { border-color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); color: var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); } .ds-side-sheet button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-hover, #e8d5b7); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-side-sheet-body { min-height: 150px; padding: 16px 18px 48px; color: #b9aa97; font-size: 0.8rem; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview:
Proforna is a restrained, near-black career workspace with the gravity of a private ledger and the clarity of an operating instrument. Warm gold rules and text establish hierarchy without turning the interface ornamental; italic serif type marks identity, reflection, and important headings, while compact sans-serif controls carry the work.

The system supports two related densities. Profile and reading surfaces use generous editorial spacing and soft or pill-shaped controls. Data-rich operating surfaces tighten the rhythm, use square-edged divisions, and allow compact rectangular controls so records remain connected rather than becoming a dashboard of interchangeable cards.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black layered surfaces with warm gold hierarchy.
Italic Playfair Display for identity and section voice; Inter for operation.
Fine rules, transparent fields, and tonal selection states instead of card grids.
Filled gold reserved for selected states and explicit primary actions.
Responsive workspaces preserve context until narrow screens require stacking.

rules.name: The Gold Is Signal Rule
rules.body: Use filled gold for a selected mode or explicit primary action; most controls remain transparent.

rules.name: The Material Exception Rule
rules.body: Light grounds belong to real output or geographic material, not to generic application containers.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif type gives identity and reflective hierarchy; sans-serif type carries actions, fields, metadata, and dense records.

rules.name: The Context-Before-Cards Rule
rules.body: Keep related records, controls, and their current visual context adjacent; do not break operating workflows into a grid of generic cards.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: Add a shadow only when a surface truly overlays, floats above, or represents a separate material.

rules.name: The Shape Follows Density Rule
rules.body: Use pills for approachable global actions and tags, but use compact rectangular controls where dense operating work benefits from sharper alignment.

dos: Do use inherited palette and type tokens before introducing surface-local values.
Do communicate hierarchy with fine rules, tonal layers, typography, and restrained gold states.
Do keep focus visible, preserve semantic controls, and disable optional motion for reduced-motion preferences.
Do let real map tiles, paper outputs, and other meaningful materials contrast with the dark application shell.
donts: Don't use filled gold broadly; its rarity identifies selection and commitment.
Don't turn connected operating workflows into interchangeable card dashboards.
Don't use decorative elevation on surfaces that are not overlays or distinct materials.
Don't introduce additional display families, hard offset shadows, or ornamental glyph icons.
